Package ID: PKG013916 is named 'Cultural Bali' and spans 8 days. The itinerary includes:
Day 1 - Kuta, Meals: N/A, Description: Kuta Arrival at Ngurah Rai, Bali International Airport, meet & greet by our local guide who led you to the parking area to board on vehicle for your transfer to your hotel. It takes about 20 minutes’ drive from the airport to your hotel or more depending on the traffic. Upon arrival at the hotel, directly check in and freshen up., GeoLocation: (Lat: 0.0, Lon: 0.0).
Day 2 - Kuta, Meals: Breakfast and Dinner, Description: Full Day Benoa Beach Tour including Banana Boat followed by Bounty Dinner Cruise on private basis. (B,D) An ideal Bali holiday is incomplete without water sports & what better than the famous Tanjung Benoa beach. This beach best known for its aquatic adventure, is located in the Benoa peninsula far away from the hustle & bustle. North of Nusa Dua this beach offers a wide range of water sports from Parasailing to Banana boat ride & so on. Please check with our representatives for all the water sports information. Many shacks & restaurants lined up along the beach make sure that your tummy is full & you enjoy the most. Later Soak in to the live musical experiences at the bridge deck, savor wide array of delectable international buffet dinner & also witnesses the live Cabaret show. Dance the night away like no one’s watching. Definitely a treat for all age groups but highly recommended for the honeymooners. A remarkable evening well spent on board the Bounty dinner cruise will always give you nostalgia for life Note:- Children below 10 years of age are not permitted to participate in water sports, rafting, swing, spa, or ATV activities. For this age group, only entrance tickets are included; participation in activities is not applicable., GeoLocation: (Lat: 0.0, Lon: 0.0).
Day 3 - Kuta, Meals: Breakfast and Local Lunch (1 Portion veg / non veg main course, 1 Refreshments), Description: Full Day Nusa Penida West Island Tour with Local Lunch on Private Basis Enjoy Breakfast at the Hotel A Full day tour to Nusa Penida West Island Tour will give you an experience you will never forget. This is a relatively undeveloped island southeast of the mainland of Bali. Nusa means Island and Penida means priests in Balinese. You won’t find the snazzy beach clubs, organic cafes or trendy restaurants here, but Nusa Penida is still worthy of a visit. It houses some of the most photogenic sights in Bali. In Nusa Penida West Island Tour, we visit 04 Points-Klingking Bay, Angel billabong, Broken beach and Crystal Bay Note: (Hotel - Bali Port - Hotel - with PVT transfers) (01 Point Snorkeling with Sharing Boat and Guide) Boat starts at 08.00 AM and back at 04.00 PM. Retribution fee to Island Nusa Penida IDR 25.000, -/person IDR 15.000/Child (Not Included), GeoLocation: (Lat: 0.0, Lon: 0.0).
Day 4 - Ubud, Meals: Breakfast and Local Lunch, Description: Transfer from Kuta to Ubud. ATV Bike Ride-Tandem (Tarantula) With Local Lunch Followed by Bali My Swing on Private Basis. Enjoy Breakfast at the Hotel For a hard-core adventurer or a novice, off-roading is the most appealing word & what better than Quad Biking while in Bali. Ride off the beaten track during your Bali vacation on your own All-Terrain Vehicle (ATV). Follow an experienced guide along a challenging track, suitable for all skill levels. One can also enjoy yourself as a co-pilot if you do not want to do it independently. No driving license required & safety is of utmost priority here. Glide past a picturesque landscape of rice fields, bamboo forest, and lush riverside flanked by traditional Balinese villages. It is an ultimate thrill for a couple of hours; you will just want to keep it going. Swings in Bali are the most trending activities across all social media platforms. And the experiences justify the popularity. Set in Ubud you must try and enjoy this incredible experience. A professional swing guide will accompany you to catch the unforgettable memory. A proper set of instructions will guide you through the equipment & safety standards. Soak in the pleasure of being a free bird, reminiscing through your childhood days. Note:- Children below 10 years of age are not permitted to participate in water sports, rafting, swing, spa, or ATV activities. For this age group, only entrance tickets are included; participation in activities is not applicable., GeoLocation: (Lat: 0.0, Lon: 0.0).
Day 5 - Ubud, Meals: Breakfast, Description: Free Day at Leisure. Enjoy Breakfast at the Hotel The rest of the day is free to explore the place at your own or indulge into optional activities from the below options., GeoLocation: (Lat: 0.0, Lon: 0.0).
Day 6 - Seminyak, Meals: Breakfast, Description: Transfer from Ubud to Seminyak Lempuyang Temple Tour followed by Authentic Balinese Massage (120 min) on Private Basis Enjoy Breakfast at the Hotel Ever wondered what it’s like to visit The Gates of Heaven. If you are visiting Bali, then this popular place must be on your list of things to see and do. Most people visit here to get an epic shot between the Candi Bentar The Gateway. This Candi Bentar is a split gateway seen in almost all Balinese entrances of religious compounds. Usually, these gateways have staircases that lead to its centre point. The two sides represent the Balinese concept of duality and the importance of maintaining a balance between darkness & the bright forces. Full Day Benoa Beach Tour including Banana Boat followed by Bounty Dinner Cruise on private basis. (B,D)
An ideal Bali holiday is incomplete without water sports & what better than the famous Tanjung Benoa beach. This beach best known for its aquatic adventure, is located in the Benoa peninsula far away from the hustle & bustle. North of Nusa Dua this beach offers a wide range of water sports from Parasailing to Banana boat ride & so on. Please check with our representatives for all the water sports information. Many shacks & restaurants lined up along the beach make sure that your tummy is full & you enjoy the most.
Later Soak in to the live musical experiences at the bridge deck, savor wide array of delectable international buffet dinner & also witnesses the live Cabaret show. Dance the night away like no one’s watching. Definitely a treat for all age groups but highly recommended for the honeymooners. A remarkable evening well spent on board the Bounty dinner cruise will always give you nostalgia for life

For a hard-core adventurer or a novice, off-roading is the most appealing word & what better than Quad Biking while in Bali. Ride off the beaten track during your Bali vacation on your own All-Terrain Vehicle (ATV). Follow an experienced guide along a challenging track, suitable for all skill levels. One can also enjoy yourself as a co-pilot if you do not want to do it independently. No driving license required & safety is of utmost priority here. Glide past a picturesque landscape of rice fields, bamboo forest, and lush riverside flanked by traditional Balinese villages. It is an ultimate thrill for a couple of hours; you will just want to keep it going.
Swings in Bali are the most trending activities across all social media platforms. And the experiences justify the popularity. Set in Ubud you must try and enjoy this incredible experience. Most people visit here to get an epic shot between the Candi Bentar The Gateway. This Candi Bentar is a split gateway seen in almost all Balinese entrances of religious compounds. Full Day Kintamani Hot Spring & Ubud village Tour (PVT Basis)
Pick up for Celuk Silver Art Village
Celuk Village is a traditional village which famous for the incredible gold and silver handicrafts are available around this area for very low prices. As you enter the neighborhood, you're going to feel as if you were in a jewelry exhibition. On either side of the road are established many art shops showcasing their finest works inside a glass display case. We will visit one of the best gold and silver art works in celuk village. You can take a closer look at them to appreciate it and buy some if you really like it or you can made custom jewelry based on your design.
Visit Mas Wooden Carved Art Village
Mas Village is one of traditional villages in Bali fundamentally as an artistic countryside by focusing the art of wood carving. This village is famous in the island as Bali Wood Carving Center located in Ubud sub district and Gianyar Regency. It owns the typical style of wood carving art by placing forward the distinguish synergy of the humanism and naturalism
Visit Kintamani Hot Spring
Kintamani Hot Spring features eight natural hot spring pools and one warm olympic sized pool. Heated deep within the earth, minerals from the colorless and odorless hot spring brings healing and curative powers. Enjoy a relaxing dip with the majestic panorama!

Enjoy Breakfast in Hotel.   When in UBUD, Bali, one of the best points of interest not to miss is Bali Swing. Take your loved ones for a thrilling yet exciting ride on the tandem swing, or if you want to feel the sensation of flying by yourself, try the single swing that goes up to 60 meters above ground. Make your trip even more unforgettable by taking pictures in various unique photo spots available, such as adorable birds nest you can sit in !
Later enjoy the local Lunch at Bali Swing Pioneer.   Proceed to spoil yourself and soothe your body and mind with our selected Balinese Massage Treatment. Using local herbs and spices along with aromatic oil, we offer a wide range of spa package including specialist treatments, facials body and foot scrub so that you can relax and escape from the stress and pressure of daily life.
Spend an unforgettable evening cruise on Bounty Dinner Cruise, Bali. Take in a breathtaking view of the sunset over Tanjung Benoa. Enjoy a delicious international buffet dinner with your loved ones. Watch various interactive performances, such as a traditional Balinese dance, comedy number and DJ performance.
Return to hotel post the tour and spend the overnight in Bali.

itinerary.description:
Royal Taman Ayun & Tanah Lot Tour (PVT Basis)
 
Enjoy Breakfast in Hotel.
Taman Ayun Temple or Pura Taman Ayun is a magnificent family temple of Mengwi empire. This one of the most visited temple in Bali, both local & Foreign tourist. Taman Ayun Temple is also one of six royal temples in Bali making it very important both spiritually and historically. This temple’s name Taman Ayun translates to the “ Garden  Temple in the Water”.
 
Tanah Lot Temple  is one of the most popular Bali Places of Interest and its an ancient Hindu Shrine perched on top of an outcrop amidst constantly crashing waves, the temple is simply among Bali not to be missed icons. The onshore site is dotted with smaller shrines alongside visitors leisure facilities that compromise restaurants, Shops and cultural park presenting regular dance performances. The temple is located in the Beraban village of the Tabanan regency, an approximate 20 km northwest of Kuta and is included on most tours to Bali western and central regions.
 
Return to hotel post the tour and spend the overnight in Bali.

Enjoy Breakfast in Hotel.  
Enjoy the Salty Air! Sandy Hair! Feel the tropical breeze and get closer to Indian Ocean with selected water sport activity. 1 x Jet Ski & Banana Boat Ride and Complimentary 1 x Parasailing 
Later proceed Uluwatu Temple sits on 70-meter-high cliff protruding above Indonesian Ocean. The main site of Uluwatu Tours is visiting this temple. There are hundreds of monkeys roaming along the path outside temple. A small forest lies at the front and hundreds of monkey’s dwells here. They are believed to guard the temple from bad influence. The Serpentine pathway to the temple is fortified by concrete walls on the cliff sides.
When sun goes down, we will witness the Theatrical Fire Dance Show ‘Kecak Fire Dance’. Kecak dance is that the accompanying music is provided by the human voice, the gamelan suara, a choir of a hundred men or more sitting in concentric circle, swaying, standing up, lying prone as the story develops. Amongst the swaying masses the voices of the storytellers can be heard telling the unfolding tale. The music generated from a combination sounds of members cak which were about 50 – 70 people all of them will make music in acapella. 
Return to hotel post the tour and spend the overnight in Bali.

This is one of the most popular and best day trip in Bali. The tour begins with the sights of a vibrant art village. Here you can meet with the people who keep the techniques of the regions handicrafts alive with a stop at Tohpati village, widely known as the centre of handmade Balinese Batik weaving. Next stop is Celuk village famous for producing high-grade gold and silver handicrafts. Continue trip to Mas Village, one of the many artists villages surrounding Ubud, is the best place on the island to find high-quality Balinese woodcarvings, considered some of the best woodcarvings in the world. The tour continues to the Mount & Lake Batur in Kintamani village for some stunning views of the beautiful locales in this region. This tour only cover viewing Mount Batur Volcano from viewpoint only. Your tour ends in one of the most famous coffee plantations in the area. Here you can look & taste many kinds of coffees from Indonesia., GeoLocation: (Lat: 0.0, Lon: 0.0).

Tanah Lot Temple stands for Earth (Tanah) and Sea (Lot), quite appropriate considering its spectacular setting on top of an impressive rock overlooking the Indian Ocean. This cultural icon is among the seven sea temples located in the coast of Bali and has been contained in Balinese mythology for centuries. In the late afternoon proceed to the southern tip of Bali for Uluwatu Sunset tour. Uluwatu Temple, or Pura Luhur Uluwatu, is renowned for its magnificent location, perched on top of a steep cliff approximately 70 metres above the waves. As one of the 6 key temples considered to be Bali's spiritual pillars, Uluwatu also offers a splendid sunset backdrop. It is definitely one of the top places in Bali for witnessing a delightful sunset, with direct views overlooking the beautiful waves of the Indian Ocean., GeoLocation: (Lat: 0.0, Lon: 0.0).

Full Day Kintamani Volcano Tour with Ubud Village on Private Basis
Enjoy Breakfast at the Hotel  A visit to Kintamani Volcano is a rare opportunity to experience one of Bali’s last remaining active volcanos up close. This is one of the most popular and best day trip in Bali. The tour begins with the sights of a vibrant art village. Here you can meet with the people who keep the techniques of the regions handicrafts alive with a stop at Tohpati village, widely known as the centre of handmade Balinese Batik weaving. Next stop is Celuk village famous for producing high-grade gold and silver handicrafts. Continue trip to Mas Village, one of the many artists villages surrounding Ubud, is the best place on the island to find high-quality Balinese woodcarvings, considered some of the best woodcarvings in the world. The tour continues to the Mount & Lake Batur in Kintamani village for some stunning views of the beautiful locales in this region. This tour only cover viewing Mount Batur Volcano from viewpoint only. Your tour ends in one of the most famous coffee plantations in the area. Here you can look & taste many kinds of coffees from Indonesia.

itinerary.description:
Full Day Tanah Lot Tour Followed by Uluwatu Sunset Tour on Private Basis
Enjoy Breakfast at the Hotel  Tanah Lot Temple, locally known as Pura Tanah Lot is probably the most popular and photographed temple on the island, located on the coastal side of Beraban countryside, Kediri sub district and Tabanan Regency. Tanah Lot Temple stands for Earth (Tanah) and Sea (Lot), quite appropriate considering its spectacular setting on top of an impressive rock overlooking the Indian Ocean. This cultural icon is among the seven sea temples located in the coast of Bali and has been contained in Balinese mythology for centuries. In the late afternoon proceed to the southern tip of Bali for Uluwatu Sunset tour. Uluwatu Temple, or Pura Luhur Uluwatu, is renowned for its magnificent location, perched on top of a steep cliff approximately 70 metres above the waves. As one of the 6 key temples considered to be Bali's spiritual pillars, Uluwatu also offers a splendid sunset backdrop. It is definitely one of the top places in Bali for witnessing a delightful sunset, with direct views overlooking the beautiful waves of the Indian Ocean.

As one of the 6 key temples considered to be Bali's spiritual pillars, Uluwatu also offers a splendid sunset backdrop. It is one of the top places in Bali for witnessing a delightful sunset, with direct views overlooking the beautiful waves of the Indian Ocean.

Inter Hotel Transfer Kuta Hotel to Ubud Hotel.   Enroute visit to Kintamani Volcano is a rare opportunity to experience one of Bali’s last remaining active volcanos up close. This is one of the most popular and best day trip in Bali. The tour begins with the sights of a vibrant art village. Here you can meet with the people who keep the techniques of the regions handicrafts alive with a stop at Tohpati village, widely known as the centre of handmade Balinese Batik weaving. Next stop is Celuk village famous for producing high-grade gold and silver handicrafts. Continue trip to Mas Village, one of the many artists villages surrounding Ubud, is the best place on the island to find high-quality Balinese woodcarvings, considered some of the best woodcarvings in the world
Evening enjoy Tanah Lot Temple, locally known as Pura Tanah Lot is probably the most popular and photographed temple on the island, located on the coastal side of Beraban countryside, Kediri sub district and Tabanan Regency. Tanah Lot Temple stands for Earth (Tanah) and Sea (Lot), quite appropriate considering its spectacular setting on top of an impressive rock overlooking the Indian Ocean. This cultural icon is among the seven sea temples located in the coast of Bali and has been contained in Balinese mythology for centuries.
